core: Upstream Wnt signaling at ligand, receptor and DVL level
qualifier: ligand secretion and non-canonical Wnt/Ca2+ branch
name: Upstream Wnt signaling with ligand secretion and Wnt/Ca2+ branch
rationale: All members concern Wnt signaling from ligand production through FZD/LRP/DVL to pathway regulation; unlike the beta-catenin/destruction-complex confusables it holds Wnt secretion (PORCN, Golgi), WNT5A/ROR2 and the calcium branch.

name: Nuclear pore complex assembly, disassembly and positioning
rationale: Every member concerns building, dismantling, reforming or localizing nuclear pores (including gene tethering at the periphery), whereas confusables cover nuclear envelope/lamina remodeling or cargo transport through the pore.

qualifier: proliferation and germinal-centre T cell help
name: B cell activation, proliferation and germinal-centre help
rationale: Members are B cell expression modules and positive regulation of B cell differentiation, proliferation and BCR signaling plus Tfh, ICOS and CD27 co-stimulation; confusables instead emphasize B cell homeostasis, negative regulation or plasma cells.

name: Vascular smooth muscle cell phenotypic switching
rationale: All members regulate VSMC proliferation, migration, apoptosis, dedifferentiation or phenotypic switching, while confusables centre on endothelial activation, vessel remodeling and VSMC development.

qualifier: ascorbate and vitamin E antioxidant responses
name: Iron homeostasis and ascorbate/vitamin E antioxidant responses
rationale: Members combine iron/heme uptake and oxygen sensing with ascorbate metabolism and responses to vitamin E, selenium and superoxide; the ascorbate/antioxidant arm separates it from the transferrin, heavy-metal and heme-biosynthesis confusables.

name: Monocyte and macrophage chemotaxis, activation and extravasation
rationale: All members concern monocyte/macrophage recruitment (chemotaxis, aggregation, extravasation, CCR2/CX3CR1 modules, RAGE signaling); confusables are generic chemokine, inflammatory-cytokine or monocyte-identity sets.

name: Neural progenitor proliferation and division in forebrain development
rationale: Members regulate neuroblast/neural stem cell proliferation, asymmetric division and neuron differentiation alongside forebrain patterning; confusables add neuronal migration, glial fate, sympathetic or dopaminergic lineages.

name: Retinal photoreceptor development and opsin phototransduction
rationale: Members cover rod/cone and retinal neuron development, outer segment organization and opsin-driven light detection; confusables are eye morphogenesis, lens or the retinoid visual cycle.

name: Cardiomyocyte proliferation, hypertrophic growth and regeneration
rationale: Members regulate cardiac muscle cell proliferation, growth, adaptation, survival and regeneration; confusables are skeletal myogenesis, heart morphogenesis, calcineurin/atrophy or vascular smooth muscle.

name: Serotonin and muscarinic receptor signaling with cAMP breakdown
rationale: Members are serotonin and muscarinic acetylcholine GPCR (and 5-HT3) signaling plus PDE1-mediated cAMP catabolism; confusables lack the cAMP-degradation arm or the serotonin receptors.

name: Radial glia-guided neuronal migration and forebrain commissure formation
rationale: Members are radial-glia-guided migration, cortical/dentate layering and corpus callosum/anterior commissure morphogenesis; confusables emphasize tangential interneuron migration or reelin and corticospinal tracts.

name: RNA polymerase I initiation and rDNA chromatin control
rationale: Members are Pol I preinitiation, promoter opening/escape and B-WICH/NoRC control of rRNA expression; confusables cover Pol I elongation/termination, Pol III transcription, rRNA processing or translation.

name: Insulin processing, incretin-stimulated secretion and GLUT4 translocation
rationale: Members span insulin processing/degradation, GLP-1/GIP-driven beta-cell secretion and insulin-triggered GLUT4 and receptor trafficking; confusables lack incretins (receptor signaling) or GLUT4 trafficking (channels, fatty-acid control).

qualifier: ER protein translocation and quality control
name: ER protein translocation, quality control and ER-Golgi export
rationale: Members cover SRP and tail-anchored ER insertion, ER folding/ERAD/retention and COPII/COPI ER-Golgi traffic (including connexins); confusables are Golgi/endosome traffic or the unfolded protein response.

name: Mitotic spindle checkpoint, midzone and contractile-ring cytokinesis
rationale: Members span spindle checkpoint, kinetochore attachment, spindle elongation/midzone and actomyosin/septin cytokinesis; confusables cover centrosomes, abscission/nuclear envelope or chromosome cohesion.

qualifier: ncRNA silencing, mRNA stabilization and splicing repression
name: Post-transcriptional mRNA stabilization, ncRNA silencing and splicing repression
rationale: Members regulate mRNA fate via miRNA/lncRNA/ceRNA silencing, IGF2BP/CRD stabilization and negative regulation of splicing; confusables centre on small-RNA biogenesis, mRNA decay or 3'-end processing.

name: Canonical Wnt/beta-catenin signaling: destruction complex and oncogenic mutants
rationale: Members are beta-catenin phosphorylation/destruction-complex regulation, TCF target control and APC/AXIN/CTNNB1/AMER1 mutants; confusables are Wnt secretion/Ca2+ branch, Hedgehog or Notch.

name: Vascular smooth muscle contraction, relaxation and arterial blood pressure
rationale: Members regulate smooth muscle contraction/relaxation, vasoconstriction and systemic/lung blood pressure; confusables centre on eNOS/NO-cGMP production or adrenergic receptor signaling.

name: TLR2/4/5 sensing of bacterial lipids and monocyte inflammation
rationale: Members are LPS/lipopeptide/lipoteichoic acid detection, TLR2/4 regulation, MyD88/IRAK4 deficiencies and monocyte inflammatory modules; confusables are inflammasome, NOD or SIRP/phagocytosis sets.

name: Skeletal muscle atrophy and restraint of myoblast differentiation
rationale: Members are muscle atrophy/inactivity responses, satellite cell maintenance and negative regulation of myoblast/myotube differentiation; confusables are pro-myogenic, cardiac or satellite-cell activation sets.

qualifier: atypical MAPKs, serine phosphorylation and TORC2
name: Growth-control kinase signaling: atypical MAPKs, serine phosphorylation, TORC2
rationale: Members are Ras/MAPK, ERK5 and ERK3/4 cascades, serine phosphorylation regulation, TORC2 and growth-control modules (LKB1/TSC2, RASA2); confusables focus on ERK inactivation and phosphatase feedback.

name: Craniofacial, limb and pharyngeal-derived organ development
rationale: Members cover face, palate, skull, nose and outer ear, limb/digit morphogenesis and thyroid, parathyroid, thymus (plus spleen) development; confusables are neural plate patterning, cardiac neural crest or inner ear/gland formation.

name: Hox-driven anterior-posterior patterning and somitogenesis
rationale: Members are Hox gene clusters, somite specification/segmentation and axis elongation; confusables lack Hox clusters or concern neural plate, dorsoventral and limb patterning.

name: Neutrophil respiratory burst and ROS-mediated bacterial killing
rationale: Members regulate superoxide/ROS generation and respiratory burst in PMN bacterial killing; confusables are macrophage/H2O2 modules, antifungal responses or degranulation.

qualifier: IL-12 production and NKT cell activation
name: IL-12 production and NKT/Th1 cytokine activation
rationale: Members cover IL-12 production and signaling, Th1 and NKT cell activation and IFN-gamma/GM-CSF production; confusables emphasize Th1 differentiation, IFN-gamma response, MHC regulation or Treg control.
